model_file: onnx/model_q4.onnx and repository-defined external data files
chat_template: repository tokenizer chat_template at pinned revision
provider_drift_limitations: Model, tokenizer and repository files are pinned by immutable revision; runtime dependencies are pinned by package-lock and audited per run.
selection_reason: Fixed 0.5B instruction-tuned CPU-compatible candidate selected before development inference to reduce the obvious 135M floor effect while remaining feasible for a 20-case paired matrix. Selection is not evidence of competitiveness.
security_scope: ephemeral isolated research runner only; no untrusted archives or images; not production-ready
